rationales.fluency: Structurally Irish but wrong vocabulary choices disrupt clarity.
rationales.grammar: Copula, particle, and progressive construction are correct; mutation sound.
rationales.idiom: Uses 'ag imeacht' (leaving) instead of 'ag dul' (going); 'seomra' (room) instead of 'siopa' (shop).
rationales.task_fulfillment: Expresses movement and present progressive but destination is wrong (room vs shop).
